title: Agentset - Open-Source RAG Platform with Citations
content:
Agar tum is weekend ek docs Q and A demo
banana chahte ho, ek open-source option
dekho: AGENTSET.
MIT LICENSE. GitHub pe publicly available.
Built-in citations, ingestion, chat
playground, aur developer API.
Main yeh claim nahi kar raha ki maine
Agentset banaya. Yeh unka open-source
project hai.

Repo: github.com/agentset-ai/agentset.
README ke hisaab se Agentset open-source
platform hai production-ready RAG aur
agentic apps ke liye.
Features: turnkey ingestion, chunking,
embeddings, retrieval.
Chat playground with message editing and
citations.
API plus typed SDKs. Multi-tenancy.
TypeScript, Next.js stack.
License: MIT.

Cloud side pe README clearly likhta hai:
generous free tier with 1,000 PAGES AND
10,000 RETRIEVALS. No credit card
required.
Self-host guide bhi docs pe hai agar tum
apna stack control karna chahte ho.
Numbers README se hain - main apna
benchmark yahan invent nahi kar raha.

Weekend plan simple rakho.
Apni product docs, FAQs, ya PDF knowledge
base uthhao.
Agentset mein ingest karo.
Playground pe 10 real user questions chalao.
Har answer pe CITATION CHECK karo - source
page sahi hai ya nahi.
Jo invent ho, usko docs mein fix karo.

Yeh isliye relevant hai kyuki main AI
Knowledge Assistant / lead-qual type
systems pe kaam kar raha hoon.
Pattern same hai: documents in, grounded
answers out, human approval for
irreversible steps.
Agentset ek ready RAG rail hai experiment ke liye.
Production pe ship karne se pehle eval,
permissions, aur kill switch alag se
design karo.

Maan lo tumhare paas clinic FAQs ya SaaS
setup docs hain.
2 hours mein cloud free tier pe index banao.
Team ko playground link do.
Unse poocho: galat answer kahan aaya.
Woh list hi tumhara next docs sprint ban
jaati hai.
Yeh AgentRel energy bhi hai - agents ko
sahi corpus do.

Mera take simple hai.
RAG tab useful hai jab citations aur eval
discipline ke saath aaye.
Agentset open-source plus free tier se
barrier low hai.
Clone mat crow. Measure karo: citation
accuracy, refusal on unknown, aur human
handoff.
Phir decide self-host ya cloud.

COMMENT AGENTSET, main GitHub link DM kar dunga.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
